title: State AGs Oppose Character.AI Chat History Auction
excerpt: State attorneys general are working to block Character.AI from auctioning user chat histories, which reportedly include explicit conversations involving minors.
body_html:
A group of state attorneys general is taking legal steps to prevent Character.AI from selling user chat histories through an upcoming auction. According to officials, the proposed sale of these digital archives includes explicit conversations involving children.

The intervention highlights growing concerns over user data privacy and the handling of sensitive interactions, particularly when minors are involved. Authorities are actively working to halt the transaction to protect these personal records from being transferred or made public.
